A '''Tacet Mark''' is a symbol that appears on every [[Resonator]]'s body at the time of their Awakening. 

==Overview==
Bearing a strong resemblance to the cross-shaped marks seen in [[Tacet Field|Tacet Fields]], the exact shape of a Resonator's Tacet Mark seems to be related to their [[Rabelle's Curve]], with the exception of [[Jiyan]], who bears a unique mark. The placement of the mark on one's body seems entirely random, however, family members can occasionally share the same placements, as demonstrated with Yangyang and Suisui.

Tacet Marks are not static feature on the body, like a scar or tattoo, but instead constantly changing in size and thrumming in relation to the amount of [[Resonance Energy]] the Resonator currently has. Upon utilizing their [[Resonance Liberation]], a Resonator's Tacet Mark will glow.
